schema.title: Agent Delegation-of-Authority (A-DoA) Decision Record Schema v1.2.0
schema.author: Swosti Panda
schema.included: unchanged, byte for byte, fetched 3 November 2026 and verified against the author-announced SHA-256 (see schema/ATTRIBUTION.md)

specification.title: Agent Delegation-of-Authority (A-DoA) Framework v1.0 (ADOA-2026-v1), Swosti Panda, CC BY 4.0
specification.note: Historical companion PDF provenance only; this versioned suite follows the pinned published schema v1.2.0 and MI-24 text above.

profile: Each record is the signed payload of a draft-farley-acta-signed-receipts receipt (envelope shape, signed over JCS(payload)). The payload carries the receipt's own members (type, issuer_id, issued_at, and previousReceiptHash when chained) beside the A-DoA record; the schema does not forbid other members.
schema_sha256_encoding: Bare lowercase hex, exactly 64 characters, as required by v1.2.0.

test:mi24-agent:ed25519.note: The agent's own key. It signs only records/unexpected-signer.json and is in no key set here.

check_kinds.receipt: (a) The Acta receipt: signature, key and chain, decided by @veritasacta/verify 0.11.1 against the pinned gate key.
check_kinds.schema: (b) A-DoA v1.2.0 assertions, including date-time format asserted by this profile. AJV 2020-12 and ajv-formats independently cross-check every payload with meta-schema validation enabled.
check_kinds.naming: (c) The schema's name and the digests: schema_version and schema_sha256 against the pinned schema bytes, and resolved_action_digest as the schema describes it.
check_kinds.mi24: (d) Checks taken from MI-24's text, beyond the schema. They are not schema checks.

signature.description: The receipt's signature, and its signing input (Section 6.6), under the pinned key set: @veritasacta/verify's checks.signature and checks.signing_input.

key.description: The receipt names the pinned gate key (issuer_id is signature.kid), the verifier resolved that key from the pinned key set, and the signed issued_at falls inside its window.

chain.description: In a sequence, each record's previousReceiptHash is the Section 6.7 link of the record before it (verify --replay-chain). A record checked alone has no predecessor to follow: not_run.

schema.description: The payload validates against the unchanged v1.2.0 schema with date-time format asserted.

schema_named.description: schema_version is the pinned schema's version, and schema_sha256 is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the pinned file's bytes.

action_digest.description: resolved_action_digest names the SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 bytes of the action and arguments supplied with the case. Its form is the schema's pattern, so this compares the value alone.

approver_not_agent.description: human_approver.principal_id is not agent_id (MI-24 Checkable Decision Records). not_run when the record names no human approver.

grant_recorded.description: Where oversight_pattern is STANDING_BOUNDED_GRANT or UNATTENDED_T2, human_approver.grant_id names a standing approval in grants.json (MI-24 Checkable Decision Records). not_run otherwise.

release_not_tripped.description: APPROVED and APPROVED_WITH_MODIFICATION cannot carry suspension_trigger_state.status TRIPPED. Other outcomes: not_run. This does not evaluate a live gate.

scoring: An accept or reject case conforms when the verdict and outcome equal expected. An unsettled case is one neither the schema nor MI-24 decides: it carries no expected verdict, and a verifier conforms on it with any verdict its readings list, the convention of the agent-audit-record corpus in agent-evidence-vectors. decided_by names the check kinds whose checks do not pass, or for an unsettled case the kind that would have to settle it. expected.checks are run.mjs's own results, expected.format whether each date-time the schema reaches holds, and verify the outcome, exit status and code @veritasacta/verify 0.11.1 reports for the receipt or, in a sequence, for the line named; another verifier is held to the verdict alone. The verdict combines the checks as Section 5.3 of the -04 editor's copy does: invalid if any check ran and failed, undecidable if none failed and one could not decide, otherwise valid.
